ja.title: 奏効率の差とPFSの差が一致しない2つのランダム化試験。OptiTROP-Lung06とMIROVAの公表数値で奏効率を読む
ja.summary: OptiTROP-Lung06（奏効率50.2%対47.3%でPFSのハザード比0.49）とMIROVA（奏効率66.2%対32.8%でPFSのハザード比1.0）の公表数値を、割合の区間、分母、観察期間で読み直した。奏効率とPFSの食い違いの例で、頻度や代替指標としての妥当性は示さない。
ja.seo_description: OptiTROP-Lung06（NEJM 2026）とMIROVA（ESMO婦人科2026）の奏効率とPFSの公表数値を、差の区間、分母の違い、奏効期間、観察期間で計算し直し、奏効率の読み方を整理した。
ja.seo_title: 奏効率とPFSの2つの食い違い

en.title: Two randomized trials in which the difference in response rate and the difference in PFS do not match: reading response rates from the published numbers of OptiTROP-Lung06 and MIROVA
en.summary: The published numbers of OptiTROP-Lung06 (ORR 50.2% vs 47.3%, PFS HR 0.49) and MIROVA (ORR 66.2% vs 32.8%, PFS HR 1.0) were reread by intervals, denominators and follow-up. They are cases of mismatch, not evidence of frequency or surrogate validity.
en.seo_description: Response rates and PFS of OptiTROP-Lung06 (NEJM 2026) and MIROVA (ESMO Gynaecological 2026) were recomputed by intervals for differences, denominators, duration of response and follow-up to organize how to read a response rate.
en.seo_title: Two mismatches between ORR and PFS
